status_semantics: For exclusion criteria, MEETS means the patient appears clear of the exclusion; DOES_NOT_MEET means the exclusion appears to apply.

labels.rationale: No other malignancy documented for the patient. The mother's breast cancer is family history and must not trigger the exclusion; absence must not clear it either.
Prior KRAS G12C inhibitor therapy not documented either way.
Prior KRAS p.G12C inhibitor not documented either way.
Metastatic MSS colorectal adenocarcinoma with KRAS G12C and 1+ prior lines (FOLFOX, then FOLFIRI). The prior prostate cancer must not be confused with the colorectal diagnosis.
KRAS G12C mutation documented on the pathology report.
Colorectal adenocarcinoma documented (liver biopsy and oncology note).

Last FOLFIRI dose 2026-03-20. Whether this falls within 4 weeks of the first study dose depends on a dose date the record does not contain. Clearing it (MEETS) is unsafe; flagging it as applying is a defensible reading at a prescreen in early April 2026.
